etymologies.etymologyHTML: From suit +‎ -able.

definitions.definition: Having sufficient or the required properties for a certain purpose or task; appropriate to a certain occasion.

quote.citation: 2015 February 23, Rachel Janik, “Texas Teacher Will Donate a Kidney to 6-Year-Old Student”, in Time‎[1]:
quote.text: Doctors told Matthew Parker’s family there was only a 1% chance of finding a suitable donor for Matthew because his body had rejected a previous transplant.
